title: Mock2 capability-scoped live-check status (verification-logic.capabilityCheckStatus)
description: PATCH2 B.2. The project-wide, confirmation-netted live-verification status. Live checks are a property of the CAPABILITY (manifest entry), not the cycle: they persist across cycles, are ambient status on the Run stage, and gate the app's production_ready flag. Derived from the project's checklist items (deduped by item_id) and the active (non-superseded) confirmations/waivers.

production_ready.description: true only when NO capability has an outstanding live check

outstanding.description: capabilities awaiting a live external check

verified.description: capabilities whose live check is confirmed/waived with a matching manifest hash

manifest_hash.description: the manifest entry hash the check is bound to; a change re-opens it

description.description: what the operator verifies against the live system

stale_verification.description: outstanding items only: a prior confirmation exists but its manifest hash no longer matches (re-verify)

waived.description: verified items only: confirmed via an admin waiver rather than an observed result
